SPECIFICATIONS

The rear wiring is connected to two sets of wiring (one for each front seat) by means of a standard connection with the pin out shown in the table below.

The different content levels are managed by the seat wiring where, on the high specification level there is a connection for the B-CAN node (NAG driver's side and NAP passenger side) for the functions for memorizing the driving seat position.
